mapper.select: select em.employee_id as employeeId, em.employee_code as employeeCode, em.company_id as companyId, em.name as name, em.email as email, em.mobil as mobil, em.phone as phone, em.id_type as idType, em.id_card_no as idCardNo, em.enabled_flag as enabledFlag from fnd_employee em where em.employee_code = #{employeeCode} and company_id = #{companyId}

SELECT sua2.user_id FROM sys_user_allocation sua1, sys_user_allocation sua2, fnd_employee_assigns fea1, fnd_employee_assigns fea2, fnd_org_position fop WHERE sua1.user_id = #{userId} AND sua1.employee_assign_id = fea1.employee_assign_id AND fea1.position_id = fop.position_id AND fea2.position_id = fop.parent_position_id AND sua2.employee_assign_id = fea2.employee_assign_id AND sua1.enabled_flag = 'Y' AND sua2.enabled_flag = 'Y' AND fea1.enabled_flag = 'Y' AND fea2.enabled_flag = 'Y' AND fop.enabled_flag = 'Y'

SELECT e1.* FROM fnd_employee e1 , fnd_org_position p1 , fnd_employee_assigns a1 WHERE a1.POSITION_ID = p1.POSITION_ID AND a1.EMPLOYEE_ID = e1.EMPLOYEE_ID AND p1.POSITION_ID =( SELECT p.PARENT_POSITION_ID FROM fnd_org_position p , fnd_employee_assigns a , fnd_employee e WHERE p.POSITION_ID = a.POSITION_ID AND a.EMPLOYEE_ID = e.EMPLOYEE_ID AND a.enabled_flag = 'Y' AND e.EMPLOYEE_CODE = #{var1} )

select em.employee_id as employeeId, em.employee_code as employeeCode, em.company_id as companyId, em.name as name, em.email as email, em.mobil as mobil, em.phone as phone, em.id_type as idType, em.id_card_no as idCardNo, em.enabled_flag as enabledFlag from fnd_employee em where em.employee_code = #{employeeCode}

SELECT fe.employee_code as employeeCode, fe.name FROM fnd_employee fe, fnd_employee_assigns fea where fea.company_id = fe.company_id and fea.employee_id = fe.employee_id and fea.enabled_flag = 'Y' and fe.enabled_flag ='Y' and fea.employee_assign_id = ( (SELECT max(sua.employee_assign_id) FROM sys_user su, sys_user_allocation sua WHERE sua.user_id = su.USER_ID and su.USER_ID = #{userId}))

SELECT e1.* FROM fnd_employee e1 , fnd_org_position p1 , fnd_employee_assigns a1 WHERE a1.POSITION_ID = p1.POSITION_ID AND a1.EMPLOYEE_ID = e1.EMPLOYEE_ID AND p1.POSITION_ID =( SELECT u.chief_position_id FROM fnd_org_unit u WHERE u.UNIT_ID =( SELECT p.UNIT_ID FROM fnd_org_position p , fnd_employee_assigns a , fnd_employee e WHERE p.POSITION_ID = a.POSITION_ID AND a.EMPLOYEE_ID = e.EMPLOYEE_ID AND a.enabled_flag = 'Y' AND e.EMPLOYEE_CODE = #{employeeCode} ) )

select em.employee_id as employeeId, em.employee_code as employeeCode, em.company_id as companyId, em.name as name, em.email as email, em.mobil as mobil, em.phone as phone, em.id_type as idType, em.id_card_no as idCardNo, em.enabled_flag as enabledFlag from fnd_employee em where em.employee_code = #{employeeCode}
SELECT e1.* FROM fnd_employee e1 , fnd_org_position p1 , fnd_employee_assigns f1 WHERE e1.employee_id = f1.employee_id and f1.position_id = p1.position_id AND p1.position_id = #{positionId}

SELECT em.employee_id AS employeeId, em.employee_code AS employeeCode, em.company_id AS companyId, em. NAME AS NAME, em.email AS email, em.mobil AS mobil, em.phone AS phone, em.id_type AS idType, em.id_card_no AS idCardNo, em.enabled_flag AS enabledFlag FROM fnd_employee em WHERE em.employee_id = ( SELECT fea.employee_id FROM sys_user_allocation sua, fnd_employee_assigns fea WHERE sua.employee_assign_id = fea.employee_assign_id AND sua.allocation_id = #{judgeUserAllocationId} )

SELECT fe.employee_code FROM sys_user_allocation sua, fnd_employee_assigns fea, fnd_employee fe WHERE sua.user_id = ( SELECT su.USER_ID FROM sys_user su WHERE su.user_name = #{startUserId} ) and fea.employee_assign_id = sua.employee_assign_id and fe.employee_id = fea.employee_id

SELECT fe.employee_code, fe.employee_id, fe.name, fop.position_id, fop.position_name, ( SELECT fou.unit_name FROM fnd_org_unit fou WHERE fou.unit_id = fea.unit_id ) unit_name FROM fnd_employee fe, fnd_employee_assigns fea, fnd_org_position fop WHERE fe.employee_id = fea.employee_id AND fea.position_id = fop.position_id AND fea.enabled_flag = 'Y' AND fe.enabled_flag = 'Y' AND fop.chief_position_flag = 'Y' AND fe.company_id = #{companyId} AND fe.employee_code = #{employeeCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT fe.employee_code, fe.employee_id, fe.name, fop.position_id, fop.position_name, ( SELECT fou.unit_name FROM fnd_org_unit fou WHERE fou.unit_id = fea.unit_id ) unit_name FROM fnd_employee fe, fnd_employee_assigns fea, fnd_org_position fop WHERE fe.employee_id = fea.employee_id AND fea.position_id = fop.position_id AND fea.enabled_flag = 'Y' AND fe.enabled_flag = 'Y' AND fe.company_id = #{compangId} and fop.position_code=#{positionCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
